idea-plugin.name: Spring Batch Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
Spring Batch Monitor Plugin for IntelliJ IDEA provides a convenient way to inspect Spring Batch jobs and steps directly from your IDE.

This plugin connects directly to Spring Batch metadata databases and provides monitoring capabilities without requiring an additional backend service.

Key Features

  • Multi-Database Support - MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, H2, SQLite
  • Job Execution Monitoring - View job execution history with detailed status and timing information
  • Step-Level Analysis - Analyze step executions with read, write, skip, and duration metrics
  • Advanced Search and Filtering - Search by job name, status, execution ID, and time range
  • Data Source Management - Configure and test multiple Spring Batch metadata databases
  • Chinese Interface - Localized UI and bilingual project documentation
  • Statistical Reports - Review success rates, execution trends, and performance signals

Quick Start

  1. Install the plugin and restart IntelliJ IDEA.
  2. Open the Spring Batch Monitor tool window.
  3. Configure a Spring Batch metadata database connection.
  4. Start inspecting job and step executions.

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2022.3 or later, Community or Ultimate Edition
  • Java 17 or later
  • Access to Spring Batch metadata tables such as BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION and BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION

No additional backend service is required. The plugin connects directly to configured databases.

License
